scope: Actual router/service with an explicit atomic RPC contract model. PASS proves application behavior against that model, not PostgreSQL transaction semantics or a deployed fix.

rows.scenario: RPC contract model: persistence fails before commit; retry recovers once
rows.expected: Failure leaves state unchanged; retry credits 25 once and subsequent replay credits zero

rows.scenario: RPC contract model: twenty concurrent route calls
rows.expected: One 25 XP credit and nineteen idempotent replays

rows.scenario: Actual SQL proposal and installed schema
rows.expected: Measure schema; approve and validate SQL privileges, rollback, locks, retries and races in isolation
rows.actual: Proposed SQL was NOT executed, including against the disposable database, per owner instruction. Shared installed schema remains unverified.
